name: Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile (UC)
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; Chilean applicants use the national PAES test, while foreign secondary-school graduates use UC's special admission route (school record, international exams such as IB, and possibly interviews). Teaching is in Spanish.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: RMIT University
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry is by secondary qualification against course minimums. English: course-specific IELTS (Academic) or equivalent, listed on each course page. Some design and media courses require a folio or selection task.
gpa_note: Course-specific minimums for your qualification; design courses also weigh the folio.

name: Rice University
tests: Test-optional, but Rice recommends submitting SAT or ACT if available. English for non-native speakers: TOEFL iBT 100 (or 5.0 new scale), IELTS Academic 7.0, Duolingo 130, Cambridge C1/C2 185.

name: University of Bologna (Alma Mater Studiorum)
tests: Admission tests vary by programme and are set out in each call: many English-taught bachelor's accept SAT or TOLC results; medicine/dentistry in English use the IMAT. Language: proof of English (often B2) for English-taught programmes, Italian for Italian-taught ones.
gpa_note: Selection usually combines school grades with the admission test score set in each programme's call.

name: University of Helsinki
tests: Admission group 1 is ranked on SAT or ACT scores (total of two tests may be considered), so SAT/ACT is effectively required for applicants with most international diplomas; IB/EB holders are ranked on diploma grades (group 2). English language requirement must be met (see university’s language requirements).
gpa_note: Group 1: ranked on SAT/ACT scores; Group 2: ranked on Finnish matriculation, IB or EB grades.

name: University of Bath
tests: SAT/ACT not required but considered if taken; US applicants need e.g. three APs at 5 (incl. Calculus) for Economics. English (Category B courses such as Economics): IELTS 7.0 (6.5 per component), TOEFL iBT 5 on the new scale (4.5 each), Duolingo 130.
gpa_note: High offers, e.g. Economics BSc: A*AA incl. Maths, or IB 36 with 7,6,6 at HL incl. Maths; US: three APs at 5.

name: Aalto University
tests: Applicants with a regular high-school diploma apply in round A on SAT or ACT (tests from 1 Jan 2025): Economics, Finance and International Business need SAT 1200+ or ACT 25+; Science & Technology and Technology-Business-Design need SAT 1350+ (Math 700+) or ACT 29+ (Math 30+). IB/EB holders are assessed on certificate grades (round B). No separate English test required for round A.
gpa_note: Round A minimums: SAT 1200 / ACT 25 (business fields) or SAT 1350 with Math 700 / ACT 29 with Math 30 (science & technology). IB/EB: certificate-based selection.

name: Macquarie University (Sydney, Australia)
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry by secondary qualification. English (most undergraduate courses): IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each band; some courses (e.g. Laws, Clinical Science, Exercise and Sports Science) require 7.0 with 6.5 per band.
gpa_note: Course-specific entry ranks converted from your qualification.

name: Aarhus University
tests: No SAT/ACT. English B-level equivalent: IELTS Academic 6.5 or TOEFL iBT (new scale 4.5 with 4.5 in each section); some programmes require English A level (IELTS 7.0, 6.0 per section). Programme-specific maths/subject requirements apply.
gpa_note: Upper-secondary diploma meeting Danish entry requirements plus programme-specific subjects; quota 2 assessment for many international applicants.

name: Universiti Sains Malaysia (USM)
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement; admission is based on pre-university results (A-levels, IB, foundation or equivalent). International applicants must show English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL/MUET or equivalent) at the level set by the university and programme; minimum scores not verified.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia (UKM)
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement; admission is based on pre-university results (A-levels, IB, foundation or equivalent). International applicants must show English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL/MUET or equivalent) at the level set by the university and programme; minimum scores not verified.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: University of Oslo
tests: No SAT/ACT. Norwegian-taught bachelor's require proof of Norwegian proficiency (UiO offers no preparatory Norwegian courses before admission). The English-taught bachelor's requires English proficiency as set in its admission rules.
gpa_note: Competitive programmes rank applicants by school grade points (converted for foreign qualifications).

name: University of Wisconsin-Madison
tests: SAT/ACT optional through spring 2028. English (if educated in a non-English-speaking country): Duolingo 115+, IELTS Academic 6.5+, TOEFL iBT 80 (test before 21 Jan 2026) or 4.5 (new scale).

name: University of São Paulo (USP)
tests: No SAT/ACT. Undergraduate entry is mainly through the FUVEST vestibular exam or ENEM/SISU; some international selection routes exist. Teaching is in Portuguese, so proficiency (e.g. Celpe-Bras) is expected.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IITB)
tests: No SAT/ACT. B.Tech/B.S. admission at every IIT is through JEE (Advanced) and JoSAA seat allocation. Foreign nationals (and OCI/PIO cardholders from 4 March 2021 who opt for it) do NOT need JEE (Main) and may register for JEE (Advanced) directly; they compete for supernumerary foreign-national seats. Teaching is in English; no IELTS/TOEFL is required.
gpa_note: Admission is by JEE (Advanced) rank; foreign-national seats are allotted on merit among foreign candidates.

name: University of Science and Technology of China (USTC)
tests: From the 2026/27 intake every international undergraduate applicant to Chinese universities must submit a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report (national requirement run by the China Scholarship Council; tests held several times a year). Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/
gpa_note: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.

name: University of Exeter
tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: profile-based (e.g. Economics Profile B1); see Exeter’s English language requirements for IELTS/TOEFL equivalents.
gpa_note: Course-specific; e.g. BSc Economics: A*AA–AAB with A-level Maths (grade B+), or IB 38/766–36/666 with HL5/SL6 Maths.

name: University of California, Davis (UC Davis)
tests: Test-blind: SAT/ACT scores are not considered for admission. English (if required): IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115, or TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before Jan 2026) / 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale (from Jan 2026). Some majors or campuses may expect more.

name: Universiti Putra Malaysia (UPM)
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement; admission is based on pre-university results (A-levels, IB, foundation or equivalent). International applicants must show English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL/MUET or equivalent) at the level set by the university and programme; minimum scores not verified.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: University of Liverpool
tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English (e.g. Economics): IELTS 6.5 with no component below 5.5, TOEFL iBT 88 (pre-2026) or 4.5 (new scale), Duolingo 125, PTE 61.
gpa_note: Course-specific; e.g. Economics BSc: AAB incl. A in Maths, or IB 34 with 6 in HL Maths.

name: Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin
tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mostly in German and require proof of German at C1 level (e.g. DSH-2, TestDaF 4x4, Goethe C2/telc C1 Hochschule). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access in Germany must attend a Studienkolleg and pass the Feststellungsprüfung. Restricted programmes (e.g. medicine) select by grade and tests.
gpa_note: Open-admission programmes accept all qualified applicants; restricted (NC) programmes rank by converted school grade.

name: University of Vienna
tests: No SAT/ACT. Almost all bachelor's programmes are taught in German: you can apply with German at A2 level, but need C1 German before you can enrol (the university's preparatory programme can bridge the gap). A few programmes require English proficiency. Some subjects (e.g. psychology, business, computer science, education) have entrance exams/aptitude tests.
gpa_note: Admission is open to holders of an equivalent university entrance qualification; restricted subjects select via entrance exams.

name: Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech)
tests: All international applicants must meet the University System of Georgia English requirement, e.g. TOEFL iBT 4.0 / 79 (pre-2026), IELTS Academic 6.5 recommended (6.0 minimum); Duolingo and an unscripted interview (InitialView/Vericant) are encouraged as extra evidence. SAT/ACT: see Georgia Tech's application review page.

name: National Tsing Hua University (NTHU)
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement (results may strengthen an application). Chinese-taught programmes require Chinese proficiency (TOCFL); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. Selection is by document review (transcripts, study plan, recommendations).
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: Western University
tests: SAT/ACT not required; international high-school curricula are assessed on grades (AP/IB considered). English for Fall 2027 (tests taken from 1 Jan 2025, before March 2027): IELTS Academic 6.5 with 6.0 in each section; TOEFL iBT 83 with 20 in each section; Duolingo 115. Lower scores can qualify for the English Boost Program.
gpa_note: Competitive high-school grades required; most programmes admit in the high-80s % range equivalent and above.

name: National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM)
tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's entry for applicants from outside the UNAM high-school system is through UNAM's competitive admission exam; foreign certificates need revalidation. Teaching is in Spanish.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: Tongji University
tests: From the 2026/27 intake every international undergraduate applicant to Chinese universities must submit a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report (national requirement run by the China Scholarship Council; tests held several times a year). Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/
gpa_note: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.

name: Khalifa University of Science and Technology
tests: EmSAT or equivalent (SAT/AP/A-levels) in maths and sciences for international curricula. English: IELTS 6.0+ / TOEFL / EmSAT English.

name: Erasmus University Rotterdam
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general. English and mathematics minimums depend on your diploma type and are listed per programme. Numerus fixus programmes (e.g. IBA, 650 places) rank applicants by grades (75%) and motivation.
gpa_note: For IBA, grades count 75% of selection points; high averages and strong maths are needed.

name: Newcastle University
tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: typically IELTS 6.5 (5.5 in each skill), TOEFL iBT 90 (pre-2026) or 4.5 on the new scale, Duolingo 125 (no sub-skill below 100); some courses higher.
gpa_note: Course-specific A-level/IB offers listed on each degree page.
